scope: Actual optional shadow helper code in Node VM using stateful mocked WebGL. Verifies resource ownership, binding/state restoration, fallback paths and draw submission. Does not compile GLSL or rasterize; browser visual review is required.

tests.name: Initialization restores previously bound program, framebuffer, renderbuffer, active unit and unit-three texture
Phone allocates the smaller 512 square shadow target
Each world layer is drawn once into a shared target with dithering disabled
Shadow pass restores main framebuffer, program, vertex buffers, viewport and fixed raster state
Incomplete framebuffer discards optional resources and returns the existing back as a valid sampler
Unsupported fragment high precision disables shadows before allocating resources
Failed shader compilation deletes program and temporary shader
Failed program linking deletes the program and both temporary shaders
Partial framebuffer allocation failure releases every resource that was allocated
Drawing failure releases optional resources and still restores the main pass
Disposal is idempotent and releases exactly four long-lived shadow resources
Reinitialization replaces existing shadow ownership without leaking old objects
